prospects.thesis: Leidos combines defense IT services with a growing digital modernization and AI-analytics backlog serving DoD, intelligence, and civil agencies — a rare defense name trading at just 1.0x sales despite +31% monthly momentum. Bullish options flow and institutional accumulation confirm smart money is positioning ahead of FY26 defense budget authorizations and continued Pentagon software/AI spend. Valuation is undemanding relative to peers, offering favorable risk/reward.

AeroVironment is the pure-play leader in tactical unmanned aerial systems (Switchblade loitering munitions, Puma drones) — a category seeing explosive demand from Ukraine lessons-learned and the DoD's Replicator initiative for attritable autonomous systems. The BlueHalo acquisition expands its counter-UAS and space capabilities, and +31.7% monthly momentum with institutional bullishness suggests order flow is accelerating. Distinct sub-niche from LDOS (drones vs. IT services).

HII is the sole builder of U.S. nuclear aircraft carriers and one of two Virginia-class submarine builders — a structural monopoly benefiting from the Navy's 30-year shipbuilding plan and AUKUS submarine commitments. At just 1.0x sales with more moderate +16% monthly gains, it offers a less-extended entry than other defense names, and its Mission Technologies segment adds unmanned/AI exposure. Institutional bullishness supports the multi-year backlog visibility.

MongoDB's document database is emerging as a preferred backend for generative AI applications requiring flexible schema and vector search (Atlas Vector Search), positioning it as picks-and-shovels infrastructure for the enterprise AI buildout. Bullish options and institutional flow into +26.7% monthly momentum signals expectations for accelerating Atlas consumption as AI workloads scale. Best-in-class AI-data play distinct from application-layer names.

Super Micro is the leading provider of liquid-cooled AI server platforms optimized for NVIDIA Blackwell/GB200 deployments, capturing outsized share of hyperscaler and neocloud buildouts. At just 0.6x sales it's the cheapest AI-hardware exposure on the list, though prior accounting overhang and lower momentum (+14.7%) argue for a Watch rating until financial credibility is fully restored. Adds semiconductor diversification not present elsewhere in the top picks.
